verdicts.reason: In A the barrel photo, the brand's key image, has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail in the bottom-left corner, and the logo is a speck beside it. The divider dash is stranded near the top, far above the headline. The tagline sits alone well below a detached watercolour block, so the layout is scattered fragments with huge dead gaps. B has the same tiny thumbnail and tiny logo, and its barrel image is squashed into an unrecognisable dark strip. It also leaves a large gap under the watercolour, but its headline, strip and tagline at least form one centred column that reads top to bottom, so it is slightly less broken.
